verdict.rationale: Grafana's tracing backend (Tempo / Cloud Traces) is documented as letting you "link your tracing data with logs and metrics." Related correlation features support the end-to-end workflow: exemplars jump from metrics to traces, metrics-to-logs switching preserves label filters, and Knowledge Graph connects metrics, logs, and traces in one workflow. missing for 10: span-level trace-to-logs/trace-to-metrics navigation details (which fields or IDs are correlated, how links are configured), and independent hands-on corroboration of the span-to-logs-and-metrics jump.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Tempo lets you search for traces, generate metrics from spans, and link your tracing data with logs and metrics.
Using Cloud Traces, you can search for traces, generate metrics from spans, and link your tracing data with logs and metrics.
Prometheus exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces by clicking on recorded exemplars.
connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow
